welcome.title: Welcome to {product}
welcome.body: Take a minute to see where things are. Press Esc to skip at any time.

new-session.title: New session
new-session.body: Start every task here. A session keeps its own conversation and context. Long sessions get slow; start a new one when a stage is done.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.body: A workspace is a folder on your computer; {product} reads and writes files only inside it. Sessions are grouped by the folder they started in.

composer.title: Describe the task
composer.body: Say what to do, where the files are and what done looks like. Type @ to reference files or sessions, / for commands and skills.

permission-model.title: Permissions and model
permission-model.body: On the left, choose what it may do: Workspace Write can create and edit files in the workspace and is the safe default; Full Access can change files outside it and system settings, so use it with care. On the right, pick the model and reasoning level.

skills.title: Skills and plugins
skills.body: Available skills and plugins are listed here. Skills are used when needed, or call them with /.

files.title: Files
files.body: Open the right sidebar to browse the workspace and preview generated documents, sheets and images.

guide.title: Want to learn more?
guide.body: The user guide covers common tasks and troubleshooting. Open it any time from the application menu.
